_meta.description: Magic Route Proxy — HTTP reverse proxy that hot-reads the routing decision (magic_target.json) on every request. Copy this file to magic_proxy_config.json and fill in your own values.

activation.comment: The proxy only activates dynamic routing when the request's 'model' matches one of these patterns; otherwise it is a pure pass-through. Put your BASE model's name here (the model Claude Code sends).

base.comment: Base model (local / low-cost) — the default routing target. The proxy rewrites the request 'model' to default_model before forwarding.

upgrade.comment: Upgrade model (cloud / strong). Primary first; if it fails, backup is tried; if both fail, the proxy falls back to base so you are never stuck.
